subject: Private deployment & audit provisions — MedSys pilot (non-standard terms)
messages:
From: Alex Grant <ciso@medsys.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Deployment & audit questions for upcoming Dedicated/On-Prem pilot

Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we prepare the procurement packet for the pilot (MedSys / Redwood), security has a handful of requirements that will be part of the legal SOW. High level:

- Data residency: All PHI and audit logs must remain within our US East datacenter and cannot be replicated outside the US.
- Audit rights: MedSys needs the right to perform on-site audits of the Redwood on-prem instance or obtain an extract of production logs (including access logs and admin actions) on a quarterly basis for the pilot.
- KMS/HSM: Customer-managed keys required; we will provide an HSM for key material.
- Deployment constraints: On-site install window only (no remote install), with a preferred weekend maintenance window.
- Liability / indemnity: We expect standard healthcare indemnities and clarity on breach notification timelines (24 hours).

These items are non-standard compared to your hosted contracts. Also, because this is a pilot on our environment with an on-prem footprint, procurement is asking for a discounted rate if we commit to 12 months of reserved capacity and handle the infra. Please let me know what is feasible — objective is to get a draft SOW this week.

Attachments: MedSys_security_questions.xlsx

— Alex
Alex Grant
CISO, MedSys Health

Alex — appreciate the clear list. I will escalate internally and loop in Legal and Sales leadership to scope which items we can accept for the pilot vs. need to negotiate.

I am attaching an SOW stub and your security questionnaire back to this thread so Legal can start redlines. Can Legal and Vivek weigh in on audit frequency, residency locking, and any suggested limits on audit scope? Also tagging Aditya for implementation constraints (onsite window / weekend install).

Attachments: MedSys_SOW_draft.pdf, MedSys_security_questions.xlsx

Thanks,

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Deployment & audit questions for upcoming Dedicated/On-Prem pilot

Marissa / team — I reviewed Alex's asks and the attached SOW stub. Summary of legal position and recommended counter-provisions: 

1) Data residency: Acceptable to require US-only deployments for this customer. We will add language that Redwood will not intentionally replicate customer data outside the agreed region. However, we cannot guarantee against transient cross-border routing for third-party services; include exception language and mitigation steps.

2) Audit rights: Full, unlimited on-site audits are high risk. Proposed compromise: allow MedSys one operational audit per 12-month period during the pilot (for the pilot we can grant one), with the audit scope limited to infrastructure and access logs. Customer may request extracts of specific logs; Redwood will provide redacted copies where required to protect other customers and system secrets. For on-site audits, require 30 days' notice and a maximum window of 2 business days.

3) KMS/HSM: We can support customer-managed keys. Customer will be responsible for procuring and maintaining the HSM; Redwood will document integration requirements and charge an implementation fee if our engineers need to validate or adapt connectors.

4) Deployment constraints: We can commit to an on-site install weekend window. We need a defined runbook and a Statement of Work with engineering hours for the install.

5) Liability / indemnity: The requested indemnity language is broader than our standard. I recommend a limited carve that is acceptable to customer for healthcare workloads but retains Redwood's standard liability caps. Any exception to caps requires executive sign-off.

Commercial suggestion: To close the pilot, Sales can offer a one-time onboarding credit plus a modest recurring discount for 12-month commits. Legal is comfortable with a 12% recurring discount plus a one-time onboarding credit up to 15% of first-year MRC as a baseline. Anything beyond that (or changing indemnity caps) needs Exec approval.

Attaching detailed redlines: redlines_med_sys.docx

If Sales wants to push to 20% recurring or remove liability caps, we need escalation to leadership (Vivek / CFO).

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 14:15:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Deployment & audit questions for upcoming Dedicated/On-Prem pilot

Vivek — I need exec approval to close MedSys this week. Summary of the ask and our recommended positions: 

- Accept US-only residency for pilot (legal ok).
- Audit: one on-site operational audit during the 12-month pilot OR provision of redacted log extracts. 30 days' notice, 2 business-day window. (Legal ok.)
- KMS/HSM: customer provides HSM; Redwood charges implementation engineering time.
- Deployment: weekend on-site install.
- Commercial: Customer requests discount for 12-month reserved capacity + on-prem responsibility. Suggested offer to close: one-time onboarding credit equal to 20% of first-month MRC (to offset services) + 12% recurring discount for 12 months. Legal recommended 15% onboarding credit max without exec sign-off; they will accept 12% recurring.

Request: please approve the one-time onboarding credit at 20% and the 12% recurring discount (or advise if you want to counter). Also confirm if you will accept Legal's limitation on audit frequency and liability caps as-is.

If you approve, I'll send the revised commercial terms and SOW to the customer and ask Procurement to sign off.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Deployment & audit questions for upcoming Dedicated/On-Prem pilot

Marissa — good summary. Approve the following to move the deal forward this week: 

- Commercial: one-time onboarding credit = 20% of first-month MRC (to be applied as a bill-credit on the first invoice). Recurring discount = 12% for 12 months. No further recurring discount without Sales leadership sign-off.
- Audit & residency: accept Legal's compromise (one operational on-site audit per 12 months for the pilot, 30 days' notice, max 2 business days; Redwood to provide redacted log extracts when feasible).
- KMS/HSM: customer to provide HSM; Redwood to bill implementation time.
- Liability caps: maintain Redwood standard caps; no exceptions without Exec/CFO approval.

Lauren / Finance: please prepare the revised quote and SOW (apply the credit and recurring discount), and ensure accounting has the billing note for the onboarding credit. Lauren, please incorporate the agreed audit limitation and residency language into the final SOW.

Marissa: proceed to send the updated commercial package and SOW to MedSys Procurement and CC Legal. Close the pilot.

— Vivek Kulkarni
VP Sales, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
